% Synthetic fixture: the long tail of a sketch's keys — an axial and a ball
% shading, a clip trimming a disc to a frame, ellipse and diamond nodes, a
% Stealth arrow between them, a label and a pin, a dashed frame fitted
% round two nodes, and a brace. Invented content and design.
\documentclass{article}

\pictures{ tool = none }

\fonts{ dir = "fonts", body = "Source Serif Pro" }

\palette{
  wash = #2A6F4E,
}

\title{Shades and Shapes}
\author{Pat Placeholder}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\section{Paint}

\begin{tikzpicture}
  \shade[left color=wash, right color=white] (0,0) rectangle (3,1);
  \shade[ball color=wash] (4.5,0.5) circle (0.5);
  \begin{scope}
    \clip (6,0) rectangle (7,1);
    \fill[wash] (6,0) circle (1);
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}

\section{Shapes}

\begin{tikzpicture}
  \node[ellipse, draw] (e) at (0,0) {oval};
  \node[diamond, draw] (d) at (3,0) {kite};
  \draw[-Stealth] (e) -- (d);
  \node[draw, label=above:top, pin=below:pin] (n) at (6,0) {node};
  \node[draw, dashed, fit=(e) (d)] {};
  \draw[decorate, decoration={brace, amplitude=5pt}] (-1,1.2) -- (4,1.2);
\end{tikzpicture}

\end{document}
